in_marathi.name: Atmananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atmananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atmananda is derived from two Sanskrit words: Atma (self or soul) and Ananda (bliss or joy). This name signifies a person who is self-contented and experiences inner peace and happiness.
